nodes.name: htmlcanvaselement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLCanvasElement interface, providing 2D, WebGL, WebGL2, WebGPU, and bitmap renderer context creation, image data extraction, and canvas rendering.

nodes.name: HTMLCanvasElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <canvas> elements providing 2D, WebGL, WebGPU, and bitmap renderer context creation, image data access, and offscreen canvas support.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Initializes shared canvas element state for dimensions and rendering context.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLCanvasElement DOM node via proto reflection.

nodes.name: data
nodes.summary: Returns raw canvas pixel data as a byte vector for image extraction.

nodes.name: set_rendering_context
nodes.summary: Associates a rendering context (2D, WebGL, WebGPU, bitmap) with the canvas element.

nodes.name: get_or_init_2d_context
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns the CanvasRenderingContext2D for 2D drawing.

nodes.name: get_or_init_bitmaprenderer_context
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns the ImageBitmapRenderingContext for bitmap display.

nodes.name: get_or_init_webgl_context
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns a WebGLRenderingContext for 3D rendering.

nodes.name: get_or_init_webgl2_context
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns a WebGL2RenderingContext for advanced 3D rendering.

nodes.name: get_or_init_webgpu_context
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes and returns a WebGPU rendering context.

nodes.name: get_gl_attributes
nodes.summary: Parses and returns WebGL context creation attributes from a JS object.

nodes.name: get_image_data
nodes.summary: Extracts image pixel data from the canvas as an ImageData object.

nodes.name: update_rendering
nodes.summary: Triggers a re-render of the canvas content, regenerating display lists.

nodes.name: SetWidth
nodes.summary: IDL setter for the width attribute, updating canvas dimensions.

nodes.name: SetHeight
nodes.summary: IDL setter for the height attribute, updating canvas dimensions.

nodes.name: GetContext
nodes.summary: IDL method returning a rendering context by type string (2d, webgl, webgpu, bitmaprenderer).

nodes.name: ToDataURL
nodes.summary: Converts canvas content to a data URL in the specified image format.

nodes.name: ToBlob
nodes.summary: Converts canvas content to a Blob object in the specified image format with callback.

nodes.name: TransferControlToOffscreen
nodes.summary: Transfers canvas rendering control to an OffscreenCanvas and returns it.

nodes.name: CaptureStream
nodes.summary: Creates a CanvasCaptureMediaStream for real-time canvas recording.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles canvas attribute changes for width/height, triggering context re-initialization.

nodes.name: htmlcollection.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of HTMLCollection providing indexed and named access to element collections with filtering, caching, and live update support.

nodes.name: HTMLCollection
nodes.summary: Live, ordered collection of DOM elements providing indexed and named access with automatic cache invalidation on document mutations.

nodes.name: new_inherited_with_kind
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection with a predefined collection kind (children, tag name, class name, etc.).

nodes.name: always_empty
nodes.summary: Creates a static always-empty HTMLCollection for consistent return values.

nodes.name: new_with_filter_fn
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection using a custom filter function for dynamic element matching.

nodes.name: new_with_source
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection from a pre-defined Vec of element sources.

nodes.name: validate_cache
nodes.summary: Checks if the cached element list is still valid based on the root node's mutation count.

nodes.name: set_cached_cursor
nodes.summary: Updates the cached cursor position for indexed element access.

nodes.name: by_qualified_name
nodes.summary: Filters HTMLCollection elements by qualified name matching tag local name and namespace.

nodes.name: by_tag_name_ns
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection filtered by tag name and namespace.

nodes.name: by_qual_tag_name
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection filtered by qualified tag name with namespace handling.

nodes.name: by_class_name
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection filtered by class name string.

nodes.name: by_atomic_class_name
nodes.summary: Creates an HTMLCollection filtered by an atomic (interned) class name.

nodes.name: filter_iter_after
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator yielding elements matching the collection filter starting after a given node.

nodes.name: filter_iter_before
nodes.summary: Returns an iterator yielding elements matching the collection filter preceding a given node.

nodes.name: elements_iter
nodes.summary: Returns the base iterator over all elements in the root, before filter application.

nodes.name: Length
nodes.summary: Returns the number of elements in the collection.

nodes.name: Item
nodes.summary: Returns the element at the specified index in the collection.

nodes.name: NamedItem
nodes.summary: Returns the first element whose id or name matches the given name string.

nodes.name: SupportedPropertyNames
nodes.summary: Returns an array of all named property names (id/name values) in the collection.

nodes.name: htmldataelement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLDataElement interface for machine-readable data representation.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLDataElement DOM node via proto reflection.

nodes.name: htmldatalistelement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLDataListElement interface providing predefined option lists for input elements.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLDataListElement DOM node via proto reflection.

nodes.name: htmldetailselement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLDetailsElement interface with shadow DOM management, summary element discovery, and exclusive-accordion group support.

nodes.name: HTMLDetailsElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <details> disclosure elements with shadow DOM content management, summary element discovery, and exclusive-accordion group coordination.

nodes.name: register_details_element
nodes.summary: Registers a details element in the name-groups map for exclusive-accordion coordination.

nodes.name: unregister_details_element
nodes.summary: Removes a details element from the name-groups map on unbind or attribute change.

nodes.name: group_members_for
nodes.summary: Returns all registered details elements sharing the same group name.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Initializes shared details element state including open state and name group.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLDetailsElement DOM node via proto reflection.

nodes.name: create_shadow_tree
nodes.summary: Creates the shadow DOM subtree for the details disclosure widget.

nodes.name: update_shadow_tree_contents
nodes.summary: Refreshes the shadow DOM content to reflect current open/closed state and slotting.

nodes.name: update_shadow_tree_styles
nodes.summary: Updates the shadow DOM styles to match the element's open/closed toggle state.

nodes.name: ensure_details_exclusivity
nodes.summary: Coordinates exclusive-accordion behavior, closing other same-name details when one opens.

nodes.name: attribute_mutated
nodes.summary: Handles open/name attribute changes, triggering shadow DOM updates and exclusivity resolution.

nodes.name: bind_to_tree
nodes.summary: Registers the details element in name groups when inserted into the document.

nodes.name: unbind_from_tree
nodes.summary: Unregisters the details element from name groups when removed from the document.

nodes.name: htmldialogelement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLDialogElement interface with modal dialog management, focus stepping, toggle event queuing, and escape-key handling.

nodes.name: HTMLDialogElement
nodes.summary: DOM class for <dialog> elements with modal/open dialog management, focus stepping, and toggle event lifecycle.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLDialogElement DOM node via proto reflection.

nodes.name: show_a_modal
nodes.summary: Implements dialog.showModal(), setting up modal dialog layer with focus trap and inert background.

nodes.name: close_the_dialog
nodes.summary: Implements dialog.close(), cleaning up modal state and returning to previous focus.

nodes.name: queue_dialog_toggle_event_task
nodes.summary: Queues a dialog toggle event as a DOM task for async event dispatch.

nodes.name: run_dialog_focusing_steps
nodes.summary: Performs the dialog focus sequence, finding the first focusable element or focusing the dialog itself.

nodes.name: Show
nodes.summary: IDL method for opening a non-modal dialog with optional return value.

nodes.name: command_steps
nodes.summary: Handles the dialog's response to Escape key events for modal dismissal.

nodes.name: htmldirectoryelement.rs
nodes.summary: DOM implementation of the HTMLDirectoryElement interface for legacy directory list element construction.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a new HTMLDirectoryElement DOM node via proto reflection.
